item.title: LVM Daily Maintenance
item.description: 1. Basic Concepts Physical Volume A PV (Physical Volume) is made up of one or more physical hard disks, and can also be a RAID device. Volume Group A VG (Volume Group) is made up of one or more PVs. Logical Volume Space carved out of a VG as an LV (Logical Volume); after formatting, it is mounted to a directory for use.
